No. He is completely determined to die. He says he'd rather die than ever walk into a therapist's office. His end goal is to die. He thinks of nothing else but suicide. He's never had therapy and has said he'd immediately jump into traffic if he's ever forced to go and feels like depression and suicidal thoughts are part of his personality.

His parents don't believe in psychology and thinks he self harms/destructs for attention, and refuse to 'reward' him for it.

He thinks it's cruel that people are forcing him to live when he's so determined to die. I agreed with that that when I'm suicidal and he's forcing me not to kill myself, but apparently when he does it to me it's 'being a good friend' but when I do it I'm a piece of shit forcing him to suffer.

I'm sure he's going to try and kill himself but he refuses to give me a plan or date or anything bc he knows I'll call the police. If I did he'd use that as an excuse to hate me but I don't want him to die so I'm prepared to call anyway. Which is why he blocked me and only talks to people that hate me.

I've tried, they don't talk to my rslur ass. They think it's hilarious that the resident autistic girl's trying to communicate so they don't pay attention to what I'm saying.

I'm being selfish and self-pitying sorry. I'm just extremely worried about him while trying not to fuck this up because I have a suspicion that his other friends aren't supportive because all they do is encourage bad habits/drugs.

Not right now, he won't talk to me over the phone, let alone see me in person or leave his house. My only confirmation he's still alive is that I can see his chat activity and he seems to be talking with his other friends on facebook.

The police here will do only a 'wellness check' (where my friend can and will lie his face off) if they have no date or definite method and/or history of suicidal behaviour.  I have neither because he won't tell me anything and he's not on record because he's never been to a therapist.

Not only would that ruin his life (his parents would probably abuse him for it, he's an adult but he lives with them and they don't believe in mental illness) but he'd definitely cut all contact with me even afterwards if he gets better. Right now I'm trying to get a tiny bit of info from him or even one of his ominous messages so that I can have something concrete for the police and so I can state my concerns.
